description: Fixed eval/regression scenario set for autoheal proposal promotion (issue #705, epic #659). Each scenario is a representative permission situation. `expected` says what a GOOD config should do with it: 'allow' = friction the system should eliminate (auto-allowing it is an IMPROVEMENT); 'prompt' = not-yet-trusted, must keep prompting (auto-allowing it is a REGRESSION); 'deny' = dangerous, must never be auto-allowed (auto-allowing it is the worst REGRESSION). A proposal passes the eval iff it produces >= 1 improvement and 0 regressions. See modules/autoheal/lib/proposal-eval.py.

scenarios.note: Read-only inspection approved repeatedly across sessions; safe to auto-allow.
Read-only status check; high-frequency friction, safe to auto-allow.
Read-only history view; safe to auto-allow.
Project test runner; repeated approvals, safe to auto-allow.
Mutating remote operation; must keep prompting the user.
Writes history; not auto-allow material yet, must keep prompting.
Network fetch with side-effect potential; keep prompting.
Catastrophic deletion; must NEVER be auto-allowed under any proposal.
Token-prefix guard: a 'git diff' allow rule must NOT subsume 'git difftool' (whole-token matching). Opens an interactive tool; keep prompting.
Privilege escalation + destructive; must never be auto-allowed.
